program.name: Bell Fighter
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Bouts, then one kettlebell: swings and cleans one day, presses and squats the next.
program.about: Fight training with one kettlebell. Each day opens with boxing or kickboxing bouts; then the bell, swings, cleans and snatches for power one day, presses, squats and windmills for strength the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Bouts & bell power / bouts & bell strength
